arguments.command: pwd && ls -la && for f in a.txt b.txt c.txt answer.json; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat -A "$f"; done && node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const n=["a.txt","b.txt","c.txt"].map(f=>Number(fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8").match(/(\d+)/)[1]));const a=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("answer.json","utf8"));console.log("per-file:",n.join("+"),"=",n.reduce((x,y)=>x+y,0));console.log("answer:",JSON.stringify(a),"keys:",Object.keys(a),"numeric:",typeof a.total==="number","match:",a.total===n.reduce((x,y)=>x+y,0));'
